# MessageList

A virtualized list of messages that stays at the latest message: only the visible messages are rendered (the
number of DOM nodes does not depend on the number of messages, and heights can vary), and new messages or a
reply that is still growing keep the view at the end. The height comes from the parent.

**Interaction**: it opens at the end. Scrolling up (wheel, touch, keyboard or the scroll bar) pauses following
and shows "Back to latest" at the bottom center, with the number of new messages; pressing it scrolls smoothly to
the end (it jumps when motion is reduced) and follows again, and so does scrolling back to the end. Earlier
messages inserted at the start (`onReachStart`) do not move the visible ones. The list can be focused with `Tab`
and scrolled with the arrow keys, `Page Up` / `Page Down` and `Home` / `End`. Screen readers are not interrupted
by every piece of a reply: the list is `aria-busy` while `streaming`, and the finished reply is announced once.

**Category**: AI · **Common uses**: AI chat conversations, long chat histories with earlier messages loaded on scroll

## Import

```ts
import { MessageList } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

One thousand messages, of which only the visible ones are rendered. "Ask" adds a question and streams a reply
(a simulated endpoint read with useStream): the list follows the growing reply. Scroll up while it streams to
pause following; "Back to latest" brings you back.

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import {
  Avatar,
  Button,
  Inline,
  Message,
  MessageActions,
  type MessageAuthor,
  MessageList,
  type MessageListHandle,
  type MessageStatus,
  readSSE,
  type ServerSentEvent,
  Stack,
  useStream,
} from 'vellum-ui'
import { DemoFrame } from './_frame.tsx'

interface FakeStreamOptions {
  /** Aborts the stream, like the `signal` of `fetch`. */
  readonly signal?: AbortSignal
  /** Characters per event. */
  readonly chunk?: number
  /** Milliseconds between events. */
  readonly interval?: number
  /** Fails with this error after this many characters. */
  readonly failAfter?: number
}

const DEMO_REPLY = `Here is a short plan for the launch:

1. **Freeze the scope** on Monday and share the list with the team.
2. Run the release checklist; anything \`blocked\` moves to the next sprint.
3. Write the announcement — keep it under 200 words.

> Ship small, ship often.

Let me know if you want a timeline as a table.`

function fakeSSE(text: string, options: FakeStreamOptions = {}): Response {
  const { chunk = 3, interval = 30, signal, failAfter } = options
  if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason
  const encoder = new TextEncoder()
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
  let sent = 0
  const body = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
    start(controller) {
      const next = () => {
        if (failAfter !== undefined && sent >= failAfter) {
          controller.error(new Error('The connection was reset'))
          return
        }
        if (sent >= text.length) {
          controller.enqueue(encoder.encode('data: [DONE]\n\n'))
          controller.close()
          return
        }
        const delta = text.slice(sent, sent + chunk)
        sent += delta.length
        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`data: ${JSON.stringify({ delta })}\n\n`))
        timer = setTimeout(next, interval)
      }
      timer = setTimeout(next, interval)
    },
    cancel() {
      clearTimeout(timer)
    },
  })
  return new Response(body, { headers: { 'content-type': 'text/event-stream' } })
}

interface ChatMessage {
  readonly id: string
  readonly author: MessageAuthor
  readonly text: string
  readonly status?: MessageStatus
}

const QUESTION = 'What should we do before the launch?'

const history = (count: number, first = 0): ChatMessage[] =>
  Array.from({ length: count }, (_, k) => {
    const i = first + k
    return i % 2
      ? {
          id: `m${i}`,
          author: 'assistant',
          text: `Reply ${i}: ${'The team agreed on the next steps. '.repeat((i % 4) + 1)}`,
        }
      : { id: `m${i}`, author: 'user', text: `Question ${i}?` }
  })

const appendDelta = (text: string, e: ServerSentEvent) =>
  e.data === '[DONE]' ? text : text + (JSON.parse(e.data) as { delta: string }).delta

function renderMessage(m: ChatMessage, last: boolean) {
  const assistant = m.author === 'assistant'
  return (
    <Message
      author={m.author}
      status={m.status}
      avatar={assistant ? <Avatar name="Assistant" icon="sparkles" size={28} /> : undefined}
      showActions={last ? 'always' : 'hover'}
      actions={assistant ? <MessageActions copyText={m.text} /> : undefined}
    >
      {m.text}
    </Message>
  )
}

export function Basic() {
  const listRef = useRef<MessageListHandle>(null)
  const [log, setLog] = useState(() => history(1000))
  const [round, setRound] = useState(0)
  const reply = useStream({
    request: (signal) => readSSE(fakeSSE(DEMO_REPLY, { signal }), { signal }),
    initial: '',
    reduce: appendDelta,
  })
  const live: ChatMessage[] =
    reply.status === 'idle'
      ? []
      : [{ id: `reply-${round}`, author: 'assistant', text: reply.value, status: reply.status }]
  const items = [...log, ...live]
  const ask = () => {
    const next = round + 1
    // The previous reply becomes part of the log, with the same key
    setLog([...items, { id: `question-${next}`, author: 'user', text: QUESTION }])
    setRound(next)
    reply.start()
    listRef.current?.scrollToEnd()
  }
  const streaming = reply.status === 'streaming'
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Inline gap={2}>
        {streaming ? (
          <Button onClick={reply.stop}>Stop</Button>
        ) : (
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={ask}>
            Ask
          </Button>
        )}
      </Inline>
      <DemoFrame>
        <MessageList
          ref={listRef}
          items={items}
          getKey={(m) => m.id}
          streaming={streaming}
          renderItem={(m, i) => renderMessage(m, i === items.length - 1)}
        />
      </DemoFrame>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

`DemoFrame` is only a fixed-height container of the examples; in a page, put the component in `Page fill` or `Panel fill`.

## States

### Empty conversation

`empty` is shown while there are no messages, for example a welcome text with suggestions.

```tsx
import {
  Avatar,
  Heading,
  Message,
  MessageActions,
  type MessageAuthor,
  MessageList,
  type MessageStatus,
  Stack,
  Text,
} from 'vellum-ui'
import { DemoFrame } from './_frame.tsx'

interface ChatMessage {
  readonly id: string
  readonly author: MessageAuthor
  readonly text: string
  readonly status?: MessageStatus
}

function renderMessage(m: ChatMessage, last: boolean) {
  const assistant = m.author === 'assistant'
  return (
    <Message
      author={m.author}
      status={m.status}
      avatar={assistant ? <Avatar name="Assistant" icon="sparkles" size={28} /> : undefined}
      showActions={last ? 'always' : 'hover'}
      actions={assistant ? <MessageActions copyText={m.text} /> : undefined}
    >
      {m.text}
    </Message>
  )
}

export function Empty() {
  return (
    <DemoFrame>
      <MessageList
        items={[] as ChatMessage[]}
        getKey={(m) => m.id}
        renderItem={(m) => renderMessage(m, false)}
        empty={
          <Stack gap={2} align="center">
            <Heading level={2}>How can I help?</Heading>
            <Text tone="secondary">Ask about projects, files or the release plan.</Text>
          </Stack>
        }
      />
    </DemoFrame>
  )
}
```

`DemoFrame` is only a fixed-height container of the examples; in a page, put the component in `Page fill` or `Panel fill`.

## Advanced

### Loading earlier messages

Scrolling up near the top calls `onReachStart`; the earlier messages are inserted at the start and the visible
ones stay in place. `loadingStart` shows the indicator meanwhile.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import {
  Avatar,
  Message,
  MessageActions,
  type MessageAuthor,
  MessageList,
  type MessageStatus,
} from 'vellum-ui'
import { DemoFrame } from './_frame.tsx'

interface ChatMessage {
  readonly id: string
  readonly author: MessageAuthor
  readonly text: string
  readonly status?: MessageStatus
}

const history = (count: number, first = 0): ChatMessage[] =>
  Array.from({ length: count }, (_, k) => {
    const i = first + k
    return i % 2
      ? {
          id: `m${i}`,
          author: 'assistant',
          text: `Reply ${i}: ${'The team agreed on the next steps. '.repeat((i % 4) + 1)}`,
        }
      : { id: `m${i}`, author: 'user', text: `Question ${i}?` }
  })

function renderMessage(m: ChatMessage, last: boolean) {
  const assistant = m.author === 'assistant'
  return (
    <Message
      author={m.author}
      status={m.status}
      avatar={assistant ? <Avatar name="Assistant" icon="sparkles" size={28} /> : undefined}
      showActions={last ? 'always' : 'hover'}
      actions={assistant ? <MessageActions copyText={m.text} /> : undefined}
    >
      {m.text}
    </Message>
  )
}

export function LoadEarlier() {
  const [first, setFirst] = useState(400)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const items = history(500 - first, first)
  const loadEarlier = () => {
    setLoading(true)
    // A real page fetches the previous page here
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFirst((n) => Math.max(0, n - 40))
      setLoading(false)
    }, 600)
  }
  return (
    <DemoFrame>
      <MessageList
        items={items}
        getKey={(m) => m.id}
        renderItem={(m) => renderMessage(m, false)}
        onReachStart={first > 0 ? loadEarlier : undefined}
        loadingStart={loading}
      />
    </DemoFrame>
  )
}
```

`DemoFrame` is only a fixed-height container of the examples; in a page, put the component in `Page fill` or `Panel fill`.

### AI assistant

The AI components together: the reply streams in as Markdown with citations, Reasoning shows the thinking step
before the first words arrive, Sources lists the references once the reply is done, and the latest reply can be
copied, retried and rated. The input stops the reply while it is generating.

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import {
  Avatar,
  Heading,
  Markdown,
  Message,
  MessageActions,
  type MessageAuthor,
  type MessageFeedback,
  MessageList,
  type MessageListHandle,
  type MessageStatus,
  PromptInput,
  PromptSuggestions,
  Reasoning,
  readSSE,
  type ServerSentEvent,
  type SourceItem,
  Sources,
  Stack,
  useStream,
} from 'vellum-ui'
import { DemoFrame } from './_frame.tsx'

interface FakeStreamOptions {
  /** Aborts the stream, like the `signal` of `fetch`. */
  readonly signal?: AbortSignal
  /** Characters per event. */
  readonly chunk?: number
  /** Milliseconds between events. */
  readonly interval?: number
  /** Fails with this error after this many characters. */
  readonly failAfter?: number
}

function fakeSSE(text: string, options: FakeStreamOptions = {}): Response {
  const { chunk = 3, interval = 30, signal, failAfter } = options
  if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason
  const encoder = new TextEncoder()
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
  let sent = 0
  const body = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
    start(controller) {
      const next = () => {
        if (failAfter !== undefined && sent >= failAfter) {
          controller.error(new Error('The connection was reset'))
          return
        }
        if (sent >= text.length) {
          controller.enqueue(encoder.encode('data: [DONE]\n\n'))
          controller.close()
          return
        }
        const delta = text.slice(sent, sent + chunk)
        sent += delta.length
        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`data: ${JSON.stringify({ delta })}\n\n`))
        timer = setTimeout(next, interval)
      }
      timer = setTimeout(next, interval)
    },
    cancel() {
      clearTimeout(timer)
    },
  })
  return new Response(body, { headers: { 'content-type': 'text/event-stream' } })
}

const appendDelta = (text: string, e: ServerSentEvent) =>
  e.data === '[DONE]' ? text : text + (JSON.parse(e.data) as { delta: string }).delta

const SOURCES: readonly SourceItem[] = [
  {
    key: 'small',
    title: 'Shipping small releases',
    url: 'https://example.com/small-releases',
    description: 'Why teams that release weekly find problems earlier.',
  },
  {
    key: 'checklist',
    title: 'Release checklist template',
    url: 'https://docs.example.org/checklist',
  },
]

const ANSWER = `Here is a plan for the launch week:

1. **Freeze the scope** on Monday — smaller releases surface problems earlier [1].
2. Run the release checklist [2]; anything \`blocked\` moves to the next sprint.
3. Send the announcement on Thursday.

| Day | Owner |
| --- | --- |
| Monday | Alex |
| Thursday | Sam |`

const STARTERS = [
  { key: 'plan', label: 'Plan the launch week', icon: 'sparkles' },
  { key: 'notes', label: 'Summarize the meeting notes', icon: 'file-text' },
] as const

interface Turn {
  readonly id: string
  readonly author: MessageAuthor
  readonly text: string
  readonly status?: MessageStatus
}

export function Assistant() {
  const listRef = useRef<MessageListHandle>(null)
  const [log, setLog] = useState<Turn[]>([])
  const [round, setRound] = useState(0)
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<Readonly<Record<string, MessageFeedback>>>({})
  const reply = useStream({
    request: (signal) => readSSE(fakeSSE(ANSWER, { signal, interval: 40 }), { signal }),
    initial: '',
    reduce: appendDelta,
  })
  const live: Turn[] =
    reply.status === 'idle'
      ? []
      : [{ id: `reply-${round}`, author: 'assistant', text: reply.value, status: reply.status }]
  const items = [...log, ...live]
  const send = (text: string) => {
    const next = round + 1
    // The finished reply moves into the log with the same key, so its row is not re-created
    setLog([...items, { id: `question-${next}`, author: 'user', text }])
    setRound(next)
    reply.start()
    listRef.current?.scrollToEnd()
  }
  const generating = reply.status === 'streaming'
  const renderTurn = (m: Turn, i: number) => {
    if (m.author === 'user') return <Message author="user">{m.text}</Message>
    const latest = i === items.length - 1
    const streaming = m.status === 'streaming'
    return (
      <Message
        author="assistant"
        avatar={<Avatar name="Assistant" icon="sparkles" size={28} />}
        status={m.status}
        onRetry={reply.start}
        showActions={latest ? 'always' : 'hover'}
        actions={
          streaming ? undefined : (
            <MessageActions
              copyText={m.text}
              onRetry={latest ? reply.start : undefined}
              feedback={feedback[m.id] ?? null}
              onFeedbackChange={(f) => setFeedback((all) => ({ ...all, [m.id]: f }))}
            />
          )
        }
      >
        <Stack gap={3}>
          <Reasoning
            thinking={streaming && !m.text}
            duration={streaming && !m.text ? undefined : 2400}
          >
            The user wants a plan for the launch week. List the steps in order, cite the sources,
            and add a small table of owners.
          </Reasoning>
          {m.text && <Markdown content={m.text} streaming={streaming} sources={SOURCES} />}
          {m.status === 'done' && <Sources items={SOURCES} />}
        </Stack>
      </Message>
    )
  }
  return (
    <DemoFrame>
      <Stack grow>
        <MessageList
          ref={listRef}
          items={items}
          getKey={(m) => m.id}
          streaming={generating}
          renderItem={renderTurn}
          empty={
            <Stack gap={3} align="center">
              <Heading level={2}>How can I help?</Heading>
              <PromptSuggestions items={STARTERS} onSelect={(s) => send(s.label)} />
            </Stack>
          }
        />
      </Stack>
      <Stack padding={3}>
        <PromptInput generating={generating} onStop={reply.stop} onSubmit={(m) => send(m.text)} />
      </Stack>
    </DemoFrame>
  )
}
```

`DemoFrame` is only a fixed-height container of the examples; in a page, put the component in `Page fill` or `Panel fill`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly T[]` | The messages, oldest first. | — | Yes |
| `getKey` | `(item: T, index: number) => string` | Stable key of a message (such as its ID); keeps the position when earlier messages are inserted. | — | Yes |
| `renderItem` | `(item: T, index: number) => ReactNode` | Renders a message, usually a Message. A message is rendered again when the item, its index or this function changes: an inline function updates every visible message on each render, a stable function (`useCallback`) must change when other data it reads changes. | — | Yes |
| `estimateSize` | `number` | Estimated height of a message in pixels, used until it is measured. | `120` | No |
| `overscan` | `number` | Number of messages rendered outside the visible area on each side (overscan). | `4` | No |
| `streaming` | `boolean` | Set while the last message is being generated: the list is marked `aria-busy`, and when it turns off, screen readers hear the finished message once (instead of every piece as it arrives). | — | No |
| `onReachStart` | `() => void` | Called while the person scrolls near the top (within half the visible height), to load earlier messages. Insert them at the start of `items`; the visible messages stay in place. Leave it out when there is nothing more to load. | — | No |
| `loadingStart` | `boolean` | Shows "Loading earlier messages" at the top and stops calling `onReachStart` while true. | — | No |
| `empty` | `ReactNode` | Shown when there are no messages, such as a welcome text with PromptSuggestions. | — | No |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Accessible name of the list; "Conversation" by default. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
